approaches.title: Iterative in-place merge with relinked nodes
approaches.summary: Iteratively compares the heads of both sorted lists and appends the smaller node to the result by relinking existing nodes. When one list is exhausted, it attaches the remainder of the other list.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses a dummy root node and a mutable tail pointer to iteratively merge the two lists in place.

revisions.commitComment: zero new heap allocations, with tricky option juggling
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 21: zero new heap allocations, with tricky option juggling
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Removes the dummy heap-allocated root and builds the result directly through an Option tail pointer, avoiding the new root allocation while preserving the same merge strategy.
